tasks.label: Git Quick Commit & Push
tasks.command: $verPath = 'version.json'; $verObj = if (Test-Path $verPath) { Get-Content $verPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json } else { [pscustomobject]@{ version = '1.0.0' } }; $bump = Read-Host 'Bump version? (y/N)'; if ($bump -match '^(y|yes)$') { Write-Host "Current version: $($verObj.version)"; $newVer = (Read-Host 'New version').Trim(); if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($newVer)) { $verObj.version = $newVer; $verObj | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content $verPath -Encoding utf8 } }; git add -A; $msg = Read-Host 'Enter commit message'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($msg)) { $msg = 'chore: update' }; git commit -m $msg; git pull --rebase; git push
